name: codex-1m
description: Use five commands to request long context in Codex, with approximately 828,400 usable input tokens in the verified environment.

interface.longDescription: Adds an MCP server and Skill that route five case-insensitive commands to install, uninstall, configure, remove, and inspect a 1,000,000-token request with approximately 828,400 usable input tokens in the verified Codex environment.
